text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Everyone! Welcome to the Tracen Academy Fan Appreciation Festival, and... the Little Kids' Campus Tour☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Today, you're going on an academy expedition with the big sisters for a Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Happy☆ time for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, keeping up with me?
Next is..."

text_block_list.name: Little Kid A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!
I lost my bunny~!
I can't take this anymooooore!!" || "Waaaaah!
I lost my bunny~!
I can't take this anymoreeeeeee!!
choice_data_list: Huh!? Oh no, I'll go look for them!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment!
Could you leave this to me?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"—We're searching for places where the flow of qi
in this academy has stagnated."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Stagnant places breed murkiness,
and trouble easily arises. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It means right here.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Little Kids
text_block_list.text: S-So... cool!!

text_block_list.name: Little Kids
text_block_list.text:
—Woooow! Everyone's so fast!
—Hehehe, what if they're even faster than me~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There might be fast Umamusume out there~? But
there's something your big sister won't lose to anyone in!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That would be my wish for all of your happiness!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Be happy, be lucky"...
I'm always wishing that for you, you know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Little Kids
text_block_list.text:
E-Even though I said such mean things...
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize! I don't mind at all☆
Alright, let's head back soon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I follow Copano Rickey's gaze.
There, I see a child looking down dejectedly.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Child
choice_data_list: (That girl, she was always off on the edge, wasn't she...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Hey, everyone!
Come over here for the finale!

text_block_list.name: Little Kids
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah~! Look at all the veggies~!
—There are flowers too~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Somewhere around here... Aha, found it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here, an orange flower!
It's for you!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Child
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "In feng shui, orange is the color that brings you good connections!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...It takes a lot of courage to strike up a conversation, doesn't it? That very first step is super scary!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, it is spring after all, isn't it?
Let's enjoy this season of new encounters together!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Child
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, um.
I've always been bad at making friends, so—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! A good turn of fate will come your way.
I mean, look—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I got to meet you! Isn't that super lucky already?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"So I know you can do it!
I'll always be cheering you on, okay? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Child
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do my best.
Um, so, you see...

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Child
text_block_list.text: So, if I can make proper friends...—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it, what is it?
...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing the children off,
I asked her what they had talked about.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~! She said she wants to see me again once she makes some proper friends! Isn't that adorable~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A tickle in my chest,
like something I felt a long, long time ago.
Feeling that, my expression softens without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I hope we hear good news!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She didn't seem to have a clue about any of it, but...
It left me with a bittersweet feeling."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I see, fans...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll have even more chances
to make you happy from now on!
Can't wait to see you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ? Is there something you want to say?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Now I'm super curious!
Hey, don't look away! Geez!
